stages.headline: A directed segment is a vector; AB starts at A and ends at B. Vectors are also named by one letter, a.
stages.headlineEnglish: A directed segment is a vector; AB starts at A and ends at B. Vectors are also named by one letter, a.

stages.headline: A vector's length (modulus) is the length of its segment, |AB| = AB; a vector whose start and end coincide is the zero vector.
stages.headlineEnglish: A vector's length (modulus) is the length of its segment, |AB| = AB; a vector whose start and end coincide is the zero vector.

stages.headline: A vector is determined by its length and direction; AB and BA have equal lengths but opposite directions.
